lines: Two house lengths this week. Two is a good winter.
People are taking the lines down off doors that never had one, and coiling them, and putting them away.
Not throwing them out. Putting them away. I have noticed that and I have not said anything about it.
Nine house lengths of rope this week. Nine.
A good winter is two. People are stringing lines to doors that never had one.
I measure rope. That is my entire job and I am extremely good at it.
A house length is door to door plus two arms, and it is different for every house,
and I know all of them. Ask me one. Go on, ask me the Hall.
